'''Tempoross''' is a cooperative [[minigame]]-style [[boss]] that is fought using skills rather than combat. 35 [[Fishing]] is required to fight it, with players assisting the [[Spirit Anglers]] in depleting its energy by fishing for and cooking [[harpoonfish]] to be loaded as cannon ammunition, then reducing its essence by fishing for energised fish.

During the encounter, players earn points towards reward permits which allow the [[reward pool]] to be searched. [[Ironmen]] are eligible for rewards from Tempoross when defeating it alongside other players.

The activity is popular as a fairly low intensity [[Fishing]] training method, offering unique drops such as the [[tome of water]], [[fish barrel]], [[tackle box]], and [[dragon harpoon]].

Subduing Tempoross 100 times is one of the requirements in order to utilise the crewmember [[Spotter Virginia]], along with 90 [[Sailing]].
